hook.say: Africa against Europe! Flat maps shrink Africa, so which is really bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Greece or Tunisia?
questions.fact: Tunisia is about 24% bigger than Greece.
questions.sayAnswer: Tunisia! It is about twenty-four percent bigger than Greece.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Belarus or Senegal?
questions.fact: Belarus is about 6% bigger than Senegal.
questions.sayAnswer: Belarus! It is about six percent bigger than Senegal.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Germany or Zimbabwe?
questions.fact: Zimbabwe is about 9% bigger than Germany.
questions.sayAnswer: Zimbabwe! It is about nine percent bigger than Germany.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Ivory Coast or Italy?
questions.fact: Ivory Coast is about 7% bigger than Italy.
questions.sayAnswer: Ivory Coast! It is about seven percent bigger than Italy.

questions.q: Which is bigger: France or Botswana?
questions.fact: Botswana beats mainland France by 5%, with about 2.5 million people.
questions.sayAnswer: Botswana! It beats mainland France by five percent, with only about two and a half million people.
